sloka: विश्राणयन्तो रत्नानि विविधानि बहूनि च ।अग्रतः प्लवगा यान्तु शिबिका तद् अनंतरम् ॥४-२५-३१॥
transliteration: viśrāṇayanto ratnāni vividhāni bahūni ca ।agrataḥ plavagā yāntu śibikā tad anaṁtaram ॥4-25-31॥

translations.english: 'Let the monkeys perform the funeral rites of our lord in an honourable way as expensively as has been done with regard to the obsequies of kings who ruled over this land.
